stack_cups: Use the left hand to pick up the cup on the left and place it into the middle cup. Then, use the right hand to pick up the cup on the right and place it into the middle cup, stacking the cups together.
put_something_into_drawer: Use the right hand to put the black wrist guard into the drawer, then use the left hand to close the drawer.
place_fruit_into_box: Use the left hand to pick up the mango and place it into the middle box. Then, use the right hand to pick up the apple and place it into the middle box.
pour_water: Use the right hand to pick up the water bottle on the right. Then, use the left hand to pick up the cup on the left, pour the water from the bottle into the cup, and use the left hand to hand the cup over.
